source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved writable controls on AMD Mem Configuration Status persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default without memory-training, topology, ECC, boot or OS regressions.
original_method: Change in-scope memory configuration fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while collecting DIMM/training/error/health evidence.
manual_activity: A human must identify writable page controls, perform approved changes and both save/reboot/default phases, and visually inspect values. Automated DIMM/ECC evidence cannot replace the firmware interaction.
required_inputs: Writable field baseline, safe non-default and SPEC-default values
Idle workload plan, console/operator, stable power and BMC/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or attempt to change status-only fields.
Do not change timing, voltage, training or interleave controls without revision-specific limits and recovery.
Quiesce workloads as approved before topology or stability-affecting changes.
Stop on training loop, DIMM/topology loss, corrected-error surge, uncorrected error, thermal alarm, hang or boot loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only SMBIOS/DIMM topology, frequency, ECC/error, OS and BMC health evidence.
Compare BIOS captures and host memory state against the approved matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, choose memory values, launch unapproved stress or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Identify writable controls versus status fields and approve the revision-specific matrix/limits/recovery.
Evaluate firmware, training and memory-health evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; memory inventory/error tools are read-only supporting checks and cannot make status fields writable or replace firmware evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual BIOS sequence for confirmed writable controls and add approved read-only DIMM/topology/ECC evidence; do not use OS memory tuning or register writes as substitutes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source AMD two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random is retained as source but cannot authorize mutation of every displayed status.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Inventory the page, label fields as writable or status-only, and for each approved control map baseline/non-default/default to expected training, topology and ECC state; capture firmware and read-only host/BMC evidence through all phases.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact AMD CPU/board/BIOS and installed DIMM population.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record CPU family/stepping, board/BIOS/vendor firmware, BMC, DIMM firmware identifiers where exposed, OS and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor memory-configuration specification and supported DIMM/limit matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents treating status as a writable control and adds training/error evidence while preserving persistence/default coverage for actual controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; status fields receive observation coverage while only explicitly supported controls are mutated.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Page-field type map, defaults, DIMM topology, limits and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some displayed values are derived training results and may legitimately vary; exact acceptance needs vendor semantics.

project_override_considerations: The project selects supported writable controls and observation fields. Results apply to the exact DIMM population and must not claim arbitrary timing/voltage or all-platform coverage.
expected_evidence: Platform/DIMM identity, approval, baseline and recovery readiness
First save/reboot persistence plus training/topology/ECC evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and memory/boot health
Final memory configuration, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source lifecycle is coherent if the page contains writable configuration controls; the word Status creates an applicability check but does not prove an opposite requirement. The exact field inventory is a readiness input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended persistence/default lifecycle is identifiable. Platform field type, values and recovery gate execution but do not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with its manual boundary and adds memory-specific training/error safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains useful read-only memory evidence but rejects PARTIAL based solely on supporting automation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores MANUAL ONLY and distinguishes writable controls from derived status fields.

review_improvement: Prevents arbitrary memory mutation and false failure of derived status values while preserving firmware persistence/default coverage for supported controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core firmware actions and visual checks are manual, so MANUAL ONLY applies. Read-only topology/error collection supports but cannot automate the acceptance path.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat memory changes, training reboot or default load after any training/error/topology anomaly; preserve first-failure evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
